changelog: Replaced multi-frame raycast polling with a zero-wait synchronous raycast in the Freecam editor to eliminate cursor flickering and missed clicks.
Upgraded 3D Debug and Freecam visualization with solid double-sided full-height boundary and polygon walls (-30m to +480m), corner pillars, and a vertical laser guide.
Added direct Teleport to Region buttons in the UI supporting both on-foot and vehicle teleportation.
